title: Pro Shop Store Credit: fraud-suspension and reinstatement terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's fraud-suspension facet across every tier: the maximum days an account may remain suspended under fraud review, whether a documented review is required before reinstatement, and the standing fee charged to reinstate a suspended account for that tier.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Maximum fraud-hold days | Documented review required before reinstatement | Standing reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 15 days | Yes | 0 USD |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 15 days | Yes | 0 USD |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 20 days | Yes | 0 USD |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 30 days | Yes | 0 USD |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 15 days | Yes | 0 USD |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 20 days | Yes | 0 USD |

## Points of reference
- The maximum fraud-hold days is the longest span a tier's account may remain suspended for fraud review; the current basis governing how that span, the review requirement and the reinstatement fee actually apply on reinstatement is stated in a separate document.
- Every tier currently requires a documented review before reinstatement, and no tier currently sets a positive standing reinstatement fee.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tier permits the longest fraud-review hold?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier, at 30 days, the longest figure among the six tiers.
**Do the two Auto-Reload tiers share the same maximum fraud-hold days?** No — Auto-Reload Standard allows 15 days and Auto-Reload Premium allows 20 days.
